description: Defines a templated TimerType class with nested TimedInfo and TimeWorker classes, managing scheduled tasks with threading and timing mechanisms, as well as a WatchDogType class for thread-based watchdog timers.

classes.name: TimerType
classes.description: A template class managing scheduled timed tasks with threading support.

classes.name: TimerType<CONTENT>::TimedInfo
classes.description: Holds scheduled time and content data for timer entries.

classes.name: WatchDogType
classes.description: Thread class implementing a watchdog timer with customizable handler.

methods.name: Schedule
methods.description: Schedules a new timer event at a specified time with content.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Clears all pending timer events and blocks the timer thread.

methods.name: HasEntry
methods.description: Checks if a specific content entry is scheduled.

methods.name: Trigger
methods.description: Triggers a timer event immediately, replacing existing if present.

methods.name: NextTrigger
methods.description: Returns the time of the next scheduled trigger.

methods.name: Pending
methods.description: Returns the number of pending timer events.

methods.name: ThreadId
methods.description: Returns the thread ID of the timer thread.

methods.name: Process
methods.description: Main processing loop for timer thread, executing scheduled tasks.

methods.name: Arm
methods.description: Activates the watchdog timer with a specified wait time.
